requirements.quote: A majority of the 14 Biosciences PhD programs do not have specific course requirements for admission.

problems: Genetics PhD page (med.stanford.edu/genetics/education/phd.html) states no admission course or math prerequisites.

Stanford Biosciences How-to-Apply page names only Biomedical Data Science, Biophysics, Molecular and Cellular Physiology and Structural Biology as home programs with course background requirements; Genetics is not among them. Same statement in the Biosciences application FAQ.
Genetics does not consider GRE General or Subject scores (Biosciences GRE table).
